podcast.title: Incorporated in Gorillaz Collaboration
podcast.body: African rhythms were specifically integrated into "Laika Come Home," the collaborative album between Gorillaz and Space Monkeyz, which featured re-imaginings of Gorillaz's first album with these distinctive influences. "se hacían versiones un tanto Rige y un tanto de ritmos africanos del primer disco de Gorillas."

podcast.title: Inspiration for Damon Albarn
podcast.body: African music, particularly its drum rhythms, has been a significant source of inspiration for Damon Albarn, leading him to undertake projects like "Mali Music" where he traveled to Africa to immerse himself in these sounds. "Daemon Alban es un grandísimo seguidor de los ritmos de tambores africanos."
